description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Notice published in Gaz. Ex. No. 2075/23 - Amendment of Regulation on non-potable spirits, was passed on 20.09.2018
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the amendment of regulations governing the importation of non-potable spirits into Sri Lanka under the Excise Ordinance. It details specific regulatory changes, substitutions, and insertions to existing rules, which falls squarely under the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) for regulatory matters, statutory instruments, and amendments to subsidiary legislation.
